abstract: This study examines the relationship between generative AI exposure and firm values. The authors analyze 678 occupations and find that generative AI exposes an average of 23% of tasks across these occupations, investigating how this technological exposure affects firm valuations and labor market dynamics.
keyFindings: 678 occupations have an average of 23% of their tasks exposed to generative AI
Generative AI exposure varies across occupations, indicating differential impacts on the labor market
